name: UCSF ImmunoExplore Summer Camp
what_you_do: You can attend a free summer camp at UCSF's Parnassus campus. It has lectures, games and Q&A sessions. It has patient panels and live anatomy dissections. UCSF students and faculty mentor you.
who_can_apply: Bay Area high school students who may have limited opportunities to engage with biomedical research, per the page. The 2026 form was for current 10th and 11th graders.
deadline_text: The page is out of date (titled Summer Camp 2025, it says 2026 applications are open). The 2026 form's deadline was May 1, 2026, and camp was set for July 27 to 31. No 2027 dates are posted, so email the program through the Contact Us link before applying.
how_to_apply: Email the program first, through the Contact Us link on the ImmunoX site, because the page is out of date. The 2026 Google Form on the page is past its May 1, 2026 deadline.
notes: These are last year's dates because 2027 dates are not posted. The camp is at UCSF's Parnassus campus. Confirm dates and grades with ImmunoX before applying.
